title: Sprint planning
summary: Plans a sprint: scopes work, estimates team capacity, sets goals and drafts the plan, including carryover.
benefit: Sprints get a realistic scope based on the team's real capacity.
solves: Sprints planned to full capacity that slip because time off and meetings were ignored.
use_cases: "/sprint-planning Sprint 12": Claude asks about team, length, backlog and carryover, then drafts the plan.
The plan has a capacity table per person, a P0 to P2 backlog, what could go wrong and key dates.
It plans to 70-80% of capacity, so interrupts do not break the sprint.
The Skill overrides part switches this skill off; remove its line under skillOverrides to use it.
details: Type /sprint-planning with a sprint name or date range, answer a few questions about your team, sprint length, backlog, carryover and dependencies, and Claude drafts a sprint plan with a capacity table, a P0 to P2 backlog, risks, definition of done and key dates. Use it when you kick off a new sprint, size a backlog against PTO and meetings, or decide what is P0 versus stretch. It installs as a skill that loads only when used; instructions only, no code runs and no network is used.
trigger: Type /sprint-planning with a sprint name or date range.
risk: Instructions only; loads when used. No code runs on its own.
